TARGETED RECHECK — exact stable off-tree SHA-256 7b5f87190977eefa5d6b06cbfb1fde46c384f22a3c6918bdc7e6a651d00787ad, 62,935 bytes.

PASS: decoded source progress is now a closed BeforeIntake / Admitted(original) / Decoded(original, decoded) family; the normative text names strict decode and StorySource construction as separate fallible stages; whitespace-only input preserves completed decoded identity/receipt; C2 carries the four discriminating controls and mutation obligations.

PASS: publication now requires a parent-anchored atomic exclusive no-replace commit, refuses when combined capability is unavailable, forbids ordinary atomic-move fallback, and C18 contains both the barrier-controlled competitor race and pathname-parent substitution court.

REMAINS AMEND: this digest predates the owners reasserted pure-HTML/CSS requirement. Sections 2.1, 3.1, 3.2, 6.1, 9.1, and 15 still allow or defer JavaScript. Apply post-01M19RGSKWYA180P4Q6SX7TB71: canonical conformance forbids script elements, inline handlers, runtime JavaScript records, and automatically loaded external resources; essential content is self-contained HTML/CSS plus inline SVG; add the three local-open mutants. A future interactive profile remains deferred.

One wording cleanup should accompany it: C2 says generic failure after byte intake but before canonical construction retains only original, which overlaps the later post-decode whitespace refusal. Rename that first case to failure after intake but before successful decode so the four stage boundaries are disjoint.

After the owner constraint repair and this C2 wording disambiguation, my prior blocker-class findings are satisfied. No public names, dependency, implementation, candidate, or landing are authorized.
